description: jobs/artifact.rs refusals emit a specific diagnostic before returning Err (FatalError means 'diagnostic already emitted', jobs/backend.rs ~40-46). jobs/native.rs has ~40 bare Err(FatalError) sites that emit nothing, so for native the only diagnostic a user sees is the generic one emit_backend_product_error (jobs/backend.rs ~129) prints from product_failed. The two layers therefore need opposite behaviour from one hook, which is why #169's before-merge pass had to stop the hook double-reporting artifact failures. Change: every native refusal names its cause (incomplete_native_program already exists; route the bare sites through it), then product_failed emits nothing and FatalError's contract holds everywhere. Signal: a program that fails native lowering prints exactly one diagnostic naming the cause; drive_test counts diagnostics per code.
title: Native lowering refusals say why: give jobs/native.rs the artifact layer's diagnostic discipline, then delete the product_failed emitting hook
